_comment: Maps the workflow's node ids to the roles Ouroboros sets. Used as-is with example_workflow.json; for your own workflow, export it with Workflow -> Export (API) into workflows/, copy this file to nodes.json and change 'file' and the node ids. Roles: positive, negative, seed, steps, cfg, sampler_name, scheduler, denoise, image (LoadImage; inpaint masks come from its alpha channel), use_reference and masked (boolean switch nodes), batch_size, checkpoint (CheckpointLoader ckpt_name), width and height (output size). lora_loader: a Power Lora Loader (rgthree) node whose LoRAs Ouroboros sets. remove_nodes drops nodes such as a Save node, so candidates don't land in your output folder.
